items.title: Stuart Bergen Interview, 1970-07-18
items.q: Oh Bobby, yeah. Bobby was there because we had a playback on it.

ctx.x: Bob Greenwood I think had the tape machine.

Oh Bobby, yeah. Bobby was there because we had a playback on it. But I think I gave all those records away I believe. The tape, I finally erased the tape and I still have part of it backwards. You know how you splice the tape backwards? As I told you, that's where I think that the patents for the original Bob came from. So they ran the tape backwards and they got the licks off, I'd say, and they used that timing. I really do believe it. Now Dick, I think we were up to 50, 1955, we were still in the union, playing…
Yeah, two of them in the back.
